autoScrollHelp: Stick to the bottom as a reply streams in (when already at the bottom).
autoTitleHelp: Name each chat from its first turn using a background model.
clearAfterSendHelp: Empty the composer (text + attachments) after a successful send.
composerSectionHelp: How the message box on this phone behaves.
inputHistoryHelp: Press ↑ / ↓ in an empty composer to recall previously sent messages.
persistDraftsHelp: Restore an unsent draft when you reopen a chat.
sectionDescription: Background helpers that shape how conversations are presented.
sendOnEnterHelp: Plain Enter sends; off makes Enter insert a newline and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter send.
streamPartialHelp: Show replies token-by-token as they arrive instead of all at once.
streamSectionHelp: How replies appear as they arrive.
timelineHelp: Show the right-edge minimap for jumping across a long chat.
